title: Starter Journey visual kit: Hosted API model picker & request builder
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design a compact, modular visual kit for the Hosted API starter journey that covers model selection, the request builder, and language-specific code snippets. The goal is to create screen assets and copy-ready snippets that docs and SDK teams can drop into the quickstart flow and marketing pages.
acceptance_criteria: Three responsive screenshots: model picker (desktop/mobile), request builder with advanced options, and completed code snippet panel
Assets exported from Figma in standard sizes (1200x800, 1024x576, 420x800) and annotated with alt text
Code snippets available for JS (fetch + SDK) and Python with identical example request parameters
Design tokens and spacing documented for engineering handoff
Accessibility checks passed for contrast and keyboard focus on interactive components
tasks: Create initial Figma frames for model picker variants (curated list, search state, empty state)
Design request builder with toggleable advanced options: temperature, max_tokens, stop sequences, streaming checkbox
Produce code snippet variants: REST fetch, Node SDK, Python requests
Run 1-hour design review with PM and frontend engineer to align copy and button labels
Export PNG/SVG assets and upload to shared Drive folder
Write alt text and short captions for each screenshot for docs ingestion
design_notes: Model picker emphasizes curated model cards (small thumbnails) with tags for latency/cost/accuracy
Request builder should show contextual help inline (hover tooltips) and a compact advanced panel collapsed by default
Code snippets use the same example prompt and model id to avoid confusion across languages
Use system font stack and Redwood brand tokens for color/spacing to ensure consistency with console
Include a tiny live example with a single-turn response in the screenshot to demonstrate streaming vs non-streaming states

ux_considerations: Keep example prompts short (<120 chars) to avoid token bloat in screenshots
Avoid using real customer data; use synthetic examples relevant to common use cases (chat summary, code generation, search rerank)
Ensure keyboard focus ring visible on model cards and request builder controls for keyboard-only users
